translations.web: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”
translations.bsb: And our enemies said, “Before they know or see a thing, we will come into their midst, kill them, and put an end to the work.”
translations.kjv: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
translations.asv: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come into the midst of them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
